I'm Tommaso Zeri. I study quantitative finance and spend most of my time on statistical arbitrage, volatility models and the places where econometrics and machine learning overlap.

## Education

- **MSc in Financial Engineering**, Systematic Trading track, EDHEC Business School, Nice (2026–2027). Academic Excellence Scholarship.
- **MSc in Quantitative Finance**, University of Bologna (2024–2026).
- **BSc in Economics**, University of Ferrara, summa cum laude.

## Activities

- Portfolio Analyst, [Riot Investment Research](https://www.linkedin.com/company/riot-investment-research/)
- Analyst, [Starting Finance Club Bologna](https://www.linkedin.com/company/starting-finance-club-bologna/)
- Financial Mathematics tutor, [letuelezioni](https://www.letuelezioni.it/insegnanti/tommaso-zeri.htm)

## Research interests

Statistical arbitrage and pairs trading, state-space and regime-switching models, GARCH-family volatility models and their hybrids with neural networks, wavelet methods for financial time series, credit risk.
